scope: Registered stationary pillars, route/fallback costs and damage, placement geometry, full lifetime damage eligibility, real solid-tile rejection, distant-aim clamp, invalid requests and death cancellation. Partial creation rollback and blocked visibility are also covered by mocked protocol tests. Temporary tile fields are restored.
limitations: Lifetime is assigned manually rather than advanced by complete world frames. No rendered targeting/physical input, live peers, late join or combat/energy balance. Existing pillar assets and damage behavior are reused.
